g.text: SleepEdit Protocol Administration and Publishing Flow
web session or desktop in-memory state
Save new empty protocol and version
Operation outcome; active snapshot is unchanged
Save new snapshot with empty undo/redo history
Saved in memory and web session when available
Load failure; no new snapshot is saved
Add, update, move, or remove nodes/subtext
Save restored snapshot and opposite history
Import failure; current snapshot is unchanged
[Publishing stops before local published state changes]
Editor snapshots provide working undo/redo state.
Draft and published versions are durable repository state.
